_doc: Cahier des charges des illustrations à générer pour les mondes 4 à 10 et les nouveaux héros. Chaque entrée devient une clé du manifeste d'art (assets/art/manifest.json). Les tailles cibles correspondent aux couches existantes des mondes 1-3 pour que le moteur les utilise sans modification. Les prompts partagent le préfixe STYLE.
STYLE: Storybook painterly 2D game art for a family platformer, soft cel shading with gentle painted textures, clean readable shapes, warm magical lighting, rich depth, consistent with a hand-painted cartoon fantasy forest game. No text, no logo, no characters unless asked.

bgd_sky.prompt: wide panoramic sky backdrop for a side-scrolling game, {sky}

bgd_hills.prompt: seamless horizontally tileable distant landscape silhouette band, transparent sky above, {hills}

bgd_forest.prompt: seamless horizontally tileable mid-distance scenery band, transparent above, {mid}

bg_forest.prompt: seamless horizontally tileable near background scenery band, transparent above, {near}

fgd_top.prompt: seamless tileable foreground overhang hanging from the top edge, blurred depth of field, {fgtop}

fgd_bottom.prompt: seamless tileable foreground silhouettes rising from the bottom edge, blurred depth of field, {fgbottom}

ground_mid.prompt: seamless horizontally tileable side-view ground block for a platformer, walkable top surface at the very top, {ground}

ground_r.prompt: right end cap of the same platformer ground block, rounded natural edge, {ground}

plat_med.prompt: medium floating platform, flat walkable top, {plat}

heroes._doc: Nouveaux designs choisis par l'utilisateur (concepts : sorcière violette, fée rose, chevalier doré). Chaque héros : planche de poses générée en une image pour la cohérence, puis découpée.
heroes.soumaya: a 9-year-old girl light guardian witch: big purple pointed hat with silver moon, long purple coat embroidered with silver stars and moons, dark curly hair in two pigtails, warm brown skin, green eyes, purple boots, small satchel, holding a wand
heroes.hajar: a 7-year-old agile explorer fairy girl: long silver-white wavy hair with a little tiara, pointed ears, translucent fairy wings, pink layered dress, holding a wooden branch wand with a sparkle
heroes.zakaria: a 4-year-old solar guardian little knight boy: messy golden blond hair, shining silver-and-gold armor, yellow scarf, blue cape, small golden sun sword
